sections: FAQs: H1, question index, questions and answers
visualCharacteristics.purpose: jump list of the questions on an FAQ page
visualCharacteristics.description: Bulleted (disc) list of blue underlined links, one per question, with ~32px space below; wrapped in a nav labelled Questions.

contentPattern.structure: block name row only (FAQ Index); no content rows
contentPattern.notes: Built at runtime from the H2s of the default content that follows the block, up to the end of main (H2s inside blocks are skipped). Each heading keeps its Edge Delivery id, or gets a slug id if it has none. With no H2s the block and its wrapper are removed. Place it right after the H1; questions are H2s, answers are paragraphs below them.

suitableFor: any long page needing an in-page jump list of its H2 sections
notSuitableFor: link lists to other pages (author a plain list)
